items.title: Journeys That Start with a Boarding Pass and Change Everything
items.summary: Sam Yniguez, UC Merced July 21, 2026 From Barcelona and Botswana to 12 ports at sea, Bobcats discover resilience, cultural fluency and life skills that stay with them long after they return home.
